bullets.text: Stream Premier League Soccer Live - Fulham faces Sunderland in a crucial match this Saturday. Watch on Peacock Premium.
HP's Battery Life Champion - The **HP OmniBook 5 14** sets a new record with over 28 hours of battery life.
X's New Profile Feature - **Elon Musk's X** rolls out an 'About this account' feature to enhance user authenticity.
Apple Wallet's Digital ID - The new **Digital ID** feature in iOS 26.1 could revolutionize identification storage.
Apple Maps Gets Smarter - iOS 26 introduces natural language search in **Apple Maps**, enhancing user experience.
Group Chat Feature for ChatGPT - **OpenAI** expands ChatGPT with group chat capabilities in select regions.
London's Thieves Prefer iPhones - Reports indicate that thieves in London are increasingly returning non-iPhone devices.
Waymo Expands Robotaxi Operations - **Waymo** receives approval to broaden its autonomous vehicle testing in California.
Meta Enters Electricity Trading - **Meta** seeks federal approval to trade electricity to support its data centers.
Black Friday Deals Are Here - Early **Black Friday** sales offer significant discounts on tech, including AirPods and laptops.
